rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for public applause and appreciative clapping.

example.english: When the concert ended, the audience gave a warm round of applause.
example.traditional: 演唱會完場，觀眾畀咗熱烈掌聲。
example.jyutping: jin2 coeng3 wui2 jyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 bei2 zo2 jit6 lit6 zoeng2 sing1
